resources.label: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.note: Free and confidential, 24 hours. Call or text 988. Available in every US territory. Spanish available. American Samoa's services are territory-wide. Verified 2026-08-01 — please call to confirm before you travel.

resources.label: National Domestic Violence Hotline
resources.note: 24 hours, free, confidential. Text START to 88788. They know what is open tonight and can talk through a safety plan. American Samoa's services are territory-wide. Verified 2026-08-01 — please call to confirm before you travel.

resources.label: National Runaway Safeline
resources.note: For anyone under 18 with nowhere to go tonight, and for anyone worried about them. 24 hours, free, confidential. American Samoa's services are territory-wide. Verified 2026-08-01 — please call to confirm before you travel.

resources.label: Veterans Crisis Line
resources.note: Dial 988 then press 1, or text 838255. For veterans, service members and their families. American Samoa's services are territory-wide. Verified 2026-08-01 — please call to confirm before you travel.
